spans.s:
Ghee or boiled butter.
E.
वस to wish, Uṇādi affix इज्, and व changed to उ.

f. (-शी)
Wish, desire.
E.
वश to wish, ई Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
1 The name of a country, (Candahar.)
2 A king, the father of ŚIVA.
E.
उशी desire, नर a man.

mn. (-रः-रं)
The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum).
f. (-री)
A sort of grass, a small sort of Saccharum.
E.
वश to desire, ईरन् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added उशीरक.

mn. (-रः-रं)
The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
E.
वश to desire, ईरन affix, श becomes षः see उशीर.

Quick, expeditious.
4 Fixed, remaining in or on.
5 Inhabited, dwelt.
E.
उष to burn, or वस to abide, affix क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Formerly inhabited by cattle.
E.
उषित inhabited, गवीन appertaining to cattle, from गो with खश् affix: see अशितङ्गवीन.

ind.
Having resided in.
E.
वस to abide, क्त्वा aff.
